title: Buffer underflow when parsing empty slice in config parser
body: When calling parse_config with an empty string or slice, the parser panics with index out of bounds on line 42 of src/lib.rs. Please add bounds check.

title: Upgrade deprecated dependency and fix compiler warning
body: The dependency 'old-crypto' is unmaintained and produces deprecation warnings on Rust 1.75+. Migrate to 'ring' or 'sha2'.
